subject: general
question: Find the percentage of material wasted in converting a cylinder of base diameter 10 cm and height 20 cm into a cone of equal base, but double the height of the cylinder.
solution:
Radius of the cone and cylinder (r) = 10/2 = 5 cm

Height of the cylinder h = 20 cm

Height of the cone H = 40 cm

As we know;

Volume of cylinder (V₁) = πr²h

Volume of cone (V₂) = (1/3) πr²H

Ratio of V₁ and V₂ = πr²h : (1/3) πr²H = 20 : (1/3) × 40 = 3 : 2

Let volume of cylinder V₁ = 3 unit

Volume of cone V₂ = 2 unit

Wastage volume = 3 – 2 = 1 unit

Percentage of wastage volume = (1/3) × 100 = 33.33%
